'''Mack''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] fighting on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He got himself injured and was being treated by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Willem]].<ref name="TOR" />
